source_caption:
Julia Roberts won the Academy Award for best actress for her role as Erin Brockovich and famously forgot to thank the real Erin Brockovich-Ellis in her acceptance speech.

Realizing her oversight shortly after leaving the stage, Julia apologized during a backstage interview with journalists, acknowledging her mistake and expressing regret, stating, "I made a big mistake. I was so upset that I forgot to thank Erin. Shame on me, shame on me! Very humbly, I thank her a thousand times.

Julia Roberts plays a real-life single mother and legal assistant who helps uncover a massive water contamination scandal caused by Pacific Gas and Electric Company. Her powerful performance earned widespread critical acclaim and swept all five major awards including Best Actress award at the Academy Awards, the Screen Actors Guild Awards, the BAFTA Awards, the Critics' Choice Awards, and the Golden Globe Awards (Best Actress - Drama).
